name: twilio-sdk
description: Install and consume the Twilio .NET SDK, grounded in a bundled SDK map. A single twilio-sdk agent plans a map-grounded contract sheet, answers narrow contract questions, and fixes SDK compile/build errors in place — cloning the SDK source only when the map cannot settle a fact. Includes the integrate-twilio router and the map-grounded twilio-sdk agent. No MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Twilio .NET SDK integration, grounded in a bundled SDK map.
